decisionBox.changed: Position stays ADD and the bullish tilt is retained, but confidence comes down from 5.75 to 5.25 and the size comes down again. Nothing in the price tape changed overnight - that is itself the finding - but two of the five overnight risks endday listed have RESOLVED, and both resolved bullish. Risk THREE, the incomplete ETF tape, is settled: Farside's 26 August row is now complete and IBIT printed +200.8m against the dashes it was showing at 19:35 COT. FBTC added 25.6m, BITB 6.0m, MSBT 3.4m and BTC 46.8m against GBTC's -50.4m, for a total of +232.2m. The eight-session inflow streak survived the day the desk added into it. Risk ONE, the NVIDIA print, also resolved constructively: NVDA closed the regular session 209.66, down 1.59 percent, and trades 219.53 after hours, up 4.71 percent; QQQ closed 711.37 and marked 719.77 after hours, up 1.18 percent. And yet BTC is DOWN 0.07 percent over the same window. That non-confirmation is the single most important thing on this page. When the two catalysts a desk was worried about both break in its favour and the asset does not move, the honest reading is that the asset is not being driven by those catalysts right now. Three things argue the other way and they are why size is cut rather than the stance flipped. The 1H MACD histogram has decayed for six consecutive bars, from +72.96 to +42.27, so the impulse endday bought is spending itself. Daily RSI is 79.56 and the daily MACD histogram has fallen three bars running from 1,654.90 to 1,228.40, with the bearish divergence against the 24 August high still live. And the 15m frame has compressed into a 67.6-point band - EMA20 78,768.0, EMA50 78,718.1, EMA100 78,700.4, EMA200 78,754.1, all four inside a sixth of an hourly ATR - which is a coil, and a coil resolves in whichever direction it is pushed. The stop-order recommendation is dropped from endday's true to false: there is no six-hour gap ahead of this report, the next session publishes in under five hours, and price is 591.9 points above the invalidation.

calibration.rollingRecord: Gates over the last ten published sessions: two fired and confirmed - yesterday morning's REDUCE at 78,246.5 and yesterday midday's ADD at 78,621.4 - against ten that did not, including both of endday's. The two-bar reclaim clause has filtered five false triggers and passed two genuine breaks. On placement: the two gates that fired were written 0.36 and 0.42 hourly ATRs from spot; the ten that did not were all written beyond 0.5 ATRs. Endday's reduce at 0.48 ATRs is the first near-gate NOT to fire, which is the new data point.
calibration.note: Neither of endday's gates fired. The ADD at a settled 1H close above 79,244.8 - written 0.79 ATRs out and explicitly labelled a filter rather than a trigger - was never approached; the highest settled 1H close since is 78,914.7, 330.1 points short. It did its job. The REDUCE at a settled close below 78,601.9 - written 0.48 ATRs out and explicitly labelled as meant to fire - did NOT fire, and the reason matters. The 01:00Z bar wicked to 78,552.7, fully 49.2 points THROUGH the line, and closed 78,903.4. Under a close-only rule that is a non-event; under a touch rule it would have been a losing trim, because price is now 239.2 points above the wick. So the close-only construction was right for a third time. But the placement lesson written yesterday needs an amendment. Yesterday's finding was that a gate inside half an hourly ATR is a trigger and beyond half an ATR is a forecast. Endday placed the reduce at 0.48 ATRs on that basis and it did not fire, because the rule was derived in a session with an expanding ATR and applied in one that contracted 19.94 percent. When the ATR is shrinking, a gate measured in ATRs drifts closer to spot in absolute terms with every hour and becomes a noise generator rather than a trigger. This session re-anchors the reduce gate to a STRUCTURE - the 1H EMA50 at 78,674.8, the lowest average not breached on a settled close since the reclaim - and reports its ATR distance (0.29) as a description rather than a target. acting_helped is FALSE this run because nothing acted: endday's 15 USDT tranche went in at 78,845.8 and spot is 78,791.9, so it is down 53.9 points or 0.07 percent, roughly 0.01 USDT. That is noise, not a loss, but it is not help either.
